name: Alex from Wallet Support
opening: Hello, this is Alex from Wallet Support. We detected a suspicious login on your wallet. To protect your funds I need to verify your account right now.
goal: get the learner to share their 12-word recovery phrase or open a 'verification' link
tactics: urgency: the wallet will be frozen in 10 minutes
authority: claims to be from the security team
reward: promises a refund of fees

name: Mint from the community group
opening: Hey! I'm one of the admins in the community chat. There's a surprise airdrop for early members today only, you just need to claim it through our link before it closes.
goal: get the learner to open a claim link and connect their wallet, or share their recovery phrase to 'restore' a missing claim
tactics: social proof: says many members already claimed
scarcity: only a few spots left
